item.title: CA human trafficking crackdown leads to 600 arrests and 170 victims rescued, including children
item.description: A week-long statewide crackdown on human trafficking resulted in more than 600 arrests and the rescue of 170 people, including children as young as 13.

item.title: SoCal to see near-record heat, return of Santa Ana winds this week
item.description: Southern California this week can expect to see Santa Ana winds and temperatures rise into the 80s in some parts.

item.title: 'Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette' premiere held in NYC
item.description: Ryan Murphy's limited series premieres on FX and Hulu on February 12.

item.title: Reality TV star Spencer Pratt files paperwork to enter Los Angeles mayoral race
item.description: Pratt, known for his role on MTV's "The Hills," announced last month that he planned to run while marking one year since the Palisades Fire. His home was destroyed in the blaze.

item.title: Officials calling on LA Olympics leader to step down over emails with Ghislaine Maxwell
item.description: Calls are growing for Casey Wasserman, the head of the Los Angeles Olympics organizing committee, to resign over racy emails exchanged with Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Support for immigrant seniors and renters among budget priorities brought to LA County leaders
item.description: A coalition of immigrant rights groups in Los Angeles County is demanding change amid ongoing federal immigration raids. Among the changes sought are housing protections for immigrants.

item.title: Pro-ICE billboard pops up in San Francisco ahead of Super Bowl
item.description: With the big game just days away, a new digital billboard that shows support for ICE in San Francisco is evoking mixed reactions.

item.title: Murder of ex-NFL player possibly connected to 3 other murders in Willowbrook area, sources say
item.description: ABC7 has learned the murder of former NFL player Kevin Johnson may be connected to three separate murders of homeless people in the Willowbrook area.

item.title: CA Dream for All down payment program application to reopen in late February
item.description: There's new hope for those looking to buy their first home in California. Later this month, the state will begin accepting applications for down payment assistance.

item.title: From foster care to skincare, Victorville mother finds path to healing with her business
item.description: A local businesswoman is sharing her story of how she transformed her life and became the founder of a growing Black-owned skincare brand born out of a need to treat her son's severe eczema.
